docstring_samples:
CATCHES: implementations that run setup multiple times per command (e.g. once
per timing run instead of once per benchmark). The setup counter file must
contain exactly 2 after benchmarking 2 commands, not 2×runs.

CATCHES: implementations that ignore --reference flag and always use the
fastest command as reference. With --reference, the specified command must
be used as the base for all relative speed calculations, regardless of whether
it's fastest, slowest, or middle.

Golden files: None — verifies reference selection via JSON and stdout.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to parse shell command lines with arguments,
treating 'bash --norc' as a single command name instead of a command with arguments.
This tests that shell specifications can include flags and they're correctly split
and passed.

Golden files:
    shell_bash_norc.golden -- output with --shell='bash --norc'
CATCHES: markdown export to stdout doesn't duplicate benchmark output

CATCHES: JSON exporters that include or omit command_with_unused_parameters
field inconsistently, or export it with wrong format when parameters are used.
Test that protected branches are shown in output.
Test handling branch names with numbers.

CATCHES: implementations that only use the last trim.delete entry or fail
to merge multiple filter specifications.

CATCHES: implementations that don't use ConfigValue::Implicit(U::default()) when
git config entries exist but are all empty — they would fail instead of falling
back to the default empty collection.

Tests lines 264-266 in config.rs: default value when entries are empty.

Golden files:
    empty_comma_items.golden -- reused since empty config behaves similarly

CATCHES: implementations that fail to detect multi-remote scenario and emit
single-remote message, don't include the generic `<remote>` placeholder text,
or fail to suggest the for-loop command that sets HEAD for all remotes.

Golden files:
    implicit_multiple_remotes.golden -- error message for multiple remotes without HEADs

expected_value_samples: b'Unable to compute the base path for the files.'
docstring_samples: Test that --no-upscale prevents upscaling of images.
Test overwrite policy 'all' - always overwrites existing files.
Test that PNG opt level over 6 is rejected.
Test that invalid overwrite policy is rejected.

CATCHES: implementations that don't handle empty file lists — they'd either crash
with index errors, process current directory as default (dangerous), or succeed silently
claiming to have compressed 0 files (confusing user who expected an error).

CATCHES: implementations that don't follow symlinks to .go files or produce
different behavior than for regular files. Should silently succeed as the
symlink points to a valid package file.

CATCHES: short commented-out code with log keyword - implementations that skip
short comments without checking for log/fmt/print keywords would miss this.

CATCHES: implementations that don't properly respect the maxResults parameter,
either not reading the configuration or not applying the custom threshold when
counting return values.

Golden files: tooManyResults_custom.golden -- warning with custom threshold of 2

CATCHES: implementations that don't detect large structs passed by value
(exceeding default 80 bytes threshold) which causes expensive copies.
Test multiple experimental checkers together.

expected_value_samples: b'wrapcheck: Checks that errors returned from external packages are wrapped'
b'error returned from external package is unwrapped'
docstring_samples:
CATCHES: implementations that don't apply default ignoreSigs when no config
file is present — would report errors from fmt.Errorf or errors.New which should
be ignored by default, or fail to report errors from json.Marshal/os.Open/io.ReadAll
which should be reported.

CATCHES: implementations that get confused by nil error returns in the same function
as unwrapped errors — they'd either miss the unwrapped error or incorrectly flag the
nil return.

Golden files: nil_error_return.golden — json.Marshal error detected, nil returns ignored
Test -debug flag enables debug output

CATCHES: implementations that fail when multiple config options are combined,
have option precedence bugs, or apply filters in wrong order. ignoreSigs and
ignorePackageGlobs should both apply.

CATCHES: implementations that incorrectly report internal sentinel errors
as unwrapped when the sentinel is defined in one file but returned from
functions in another file of the same package -- would wrongly flag ErrNotFound,
ErrAlreadyExists, ErrInvalidInput as unwrapped even though they're internal
sentinels defined in errors.go and returned from handlers.go functions.

Golden files: None (empty output expected)
Test detection of list ++ [] concatenation.
Test running with no arguments shows help.
CATCHES: implementations that don't lint let bindings in streaming mode.

CATCHES: implementations that disable all fixes when a config file is present,
instead of only disabling the specified lints.
Test snapshot against ./executable output.

CATCHES: implementations that incorrectly report differences when files are
identical — git diff should exit 0 when files are the same, and produce no
diff output.

CATCHES: implementations that don't recognize bright color names (brightred, brightblue,
etc), map them to regular colors instead of bright variants, or emit wrong ANSI codes for
bright colors (should use codes 90-97 or 256-color equivalents).

Golden files: brightred.out -- ./executable --no-gitconfig --minus-style "brightred"

CATCHES: implementations that apply the 'g' flag to content instead of filenames,
don't replace all matches when 'g' is specified, or only replace the first occurrence
even with the global flag enabled.

Golden files: 
    without_g_flag.golden -- only first / replaced with _
    with_g_flag.golden -- all / replaced with _

CATCHES: implementations that don't properly parse two-color specifications (foreground
then background), swap the order, apply wrong colors, or fail to handle named colors
correctly when two are specified together.

Golden files: red_blue.out -- ./executable --no-gitconfig --minus-style "red blue"
With exactly 2 file args, delta treats them as MINUS_FILE and PLUS_FILE.
Test -v/--verbose flag shows full commands.
Test depfile with missing dependency.
Test tracking of generated files in deps log.
Test concatenating three inputs.

CATCHES: implementations that silently ignore unknown targets or that
crash instead of emitting a clear error message.

expected_value_samples: b'List the hashes of all orphan cards'
docstring_samples:
CATCHES: implementations that don't enforce MIN_INTERVAL (1 day) —
very low stability values should still produce interval_days >= 1, not 0.
Should handle reference to missing image.
Each subcommand help should be different from main help.
Test parsing cards with Windows line endings (CRLF).

CATCHES: implementations that don't properly implement full mode with all
four grading buttons, fail to show Hard/Easy buttons, or mix up binary and
full modes — they'd either show wrong number of buttons or wrong labels.

CATCHES: implementations that process files multiple times when directory arguments
overlap, or that fail when same file appears in multiple searched paths.

CATCHES: implementations that strip standalone comment lines, lose comments
during formatting, or fail to preserve comment-only lines at various positions
(start, middle, end of file).

Golden files: standalone_comment.golden -- output with standalone comments

CATCHES: implementations that only wrap the first long line, lose
state between lines, or produce inconsistent wrapping behavior across
multiple lines in the same document.

Golden files: multiple_long_lines.golden -- output with two long lines
Test formatting description environment.

CATCHES: implementations that fail when using relative paths with --recursive,
or that resolve paths incorrectly when cwd differs from file location.
